summary: Finney Peak's 1933 L-4 cab was abandoned in 1965 and reported destroyed by 1983; the road and trail are now overgrown.

facts.design: L-4 cab; described in 1950 as a standard 14-foot square building painted white
facts.status_note: Cab abandoned in 1965; a 1983 USGS visit reported the lookout house destroyed.

visit.trail_note: Willhite's 2023 account: road choked with alder and washed out; route about 4.5 miles one way with 2,500 ft gain.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register dates the panoramas 8-29-35; Willhite captions the southeast view August 28, 1935. Both place them in late August 1935.
Willhite's header says good gravel roads, but the same page's text describes a washed-out, overgrown road in 2023. The story follows the text.

sources.title: Finney Peak Lookout Site, US 1925
sources.publisher: Former Fire Lookout Sites Register, firetower.org

notes_for_editor: Built, abandonment and destruction dates agree across both sources. Staffing rests on one 1953 entry from Willhite. Access is not stated in law; the road and trail description is from a 2023 account, and the header conflicts with it. One WebSearch returned a SummitPost page claiming a 2-mile trail from the north; not verified on a fetched page, so left out.
